name: Insurance
overview: Scripture encourages wise stewardship and care for others, emphasizing the importance of generosity toward those in need and prudent preparation for the future. Believers are called to not harden their hearts against the poor but to provide support (Deuteronomy 15:7), while also recognizing that wealth can serve as a strong defense (Proverbs 10:15). Planning and counsel are vital, as Proverbs highlights the value of seeking advice and preparing one’s work before building a home (Proverbs 15:22, 24:27). Additionally, diligence in managing one’s resources is commended (Proverbs 27:23), and leaving an inheritance for future generations is seen as a mark of a good man (Proverbs 13:22). These principles align with the concept of life insurance as a means of responsible provision and protection for family and dependents.
